pdr.title: Paintless dent repair
pdr.short: Precise dent removal without painting or body filler.

hail.short: Effective hail repair while keeping factory paint.
hail.description: Hail can leave hundreds of dents. With PDR we restore roofs, hoods and panels without costly resprays — often with insurer coordination.

parking.short: Fast repair of dents from parking incidents.
parking.description: Quick repair — dents are often removed in as little as 30 minutes up to a few hours. Neighbour’s door, shopping cart or bollard — without a traditional body shop visit.

vandalism.title: Vandalism damage
vandalism.short: Restore appearance after intentional body damage.
vandalism.description: Dents from kicks or deliberate impacts can be repaired with PDR when the paint remains unbroken.

classic.title: Classic cars

classic.description: On classics, original paint matters. PDR repairs metal without losing authenticity or collector value.

prep.title: Prep for painting

prep.description: When paint must be repaired, PDR helps push metal out and reduce filler before spraying.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Straight answers about PDR and working with us.

1.a: PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) removes dents by carefully massaging metal from behind — without filler or paint when the finish is undamaged.

2.a: If paint is cracked or chipped, or metal is severely stretched, conventional bodywork may be needed. We can still prep panels for painting.

3.q: How does a photo quote work?
3.a: Send a few clear photos (close-up and wider shots) via the form or WhatsApp. We reply with an estimate and proposed slot.

4.q: How long does a repair take?
4.a: A single parking dent often takes hours. Heavy hail may need 1–3 days. We confirm timing with your quote.

5.a: Yes — we help with hail claims and provide documentation insurers typically require.

6.a: Yes — mobile PDR across Poznań and surrounding areas. Details are confirmed with your quote.
